Resolves #21462

🌿 *A unit run can no longer go red because a test pulled a stub out from under a dialog it had not yet destroyed.*

`test/playwright/unit/dialog/Close.spec.mjs` now destroys its dialogs before it restores `Neo.applyDeltas` and the `DomAccess` stubs. Since #21433 a mounted modal dialog syncs its mask away in `destroy()`, and the old order deleted `syncModalMask` first, so `:181` threw in every `unit` job based on `f04f579a5f` (#21458, #21450, #21405).

Evidence: L2 (the spec in CI) → L2 required (AC-1). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/dialog/Close.spec.mjs` in the `unit` job of this head. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

Local on `dev` `e2272a9f2b`: before, `Close.spec.mjs:181` fails every run with `TypeError: Neo.main.DomAccess.syncModalMask is not a function` at the hook's `destroy()` line; after, the dialog specs pass (24), and the other specs that mount dialogs (board, desktop, workstation planning stores) pass (111).

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The next `unit` run of #21458 and #21450 after they merge `dev` is green on `Close.spec.mjs`.
